results.name: Park Güell
results.principal_activities: Strolling through Gaudí's mosaic terraces, panoramic city views, garden walks
results.why_it_is_special: A UNESCO-listed park with 20 hectares of gardens and iconic Gaudí architecture offering a spectacular 360° panorama over Barcelona and the sea

results.name: Parc de la Ciutadella
results.principal_activities: Picnicking, rowing on the lake, walking among palm-lined paths, visiting the Cascada Monumental fountain
results.why_it_is_special: Barcelona's 18-hectare urban "green lung," built on the site of a former military citadel and home to relics of the 1888 Universal Exhibition, the Barcelona Zoo, and lush gardens

results.name: Montjuïc Hill & Gardens
results.principal_activities: Botanical trail, visiting the Jardí Botànic and Jardins de Costa i Llobera (cactus garden), cable-car rides, hilltop walks with sea views
results.why_it_is_special: A 250-hectare hilltop complex with a constellation of themed gardens, Olympic-era landmarks, and panoramic Mediterranean views — including one of Europe's most important cactus and succulent collections

results.name: Collserola Natural Park & Mount Tibidabo
results.principal_activities: Forest hiking (2–2.5 hrs to summit), birdwatching, wildlife spotting (wild boar), panoramic views from the Norman Foster communications tower
results.why_it_is_special: Barcelona's largest green space — miles of forested trails on the city's doorstep, crowned by the 512 m Tibidabo summit with views over the city on one side and the Vallès plain on the other

results.name: Barceloneta Beach & Seafront
results.principal_activities: Swimming, beach volleyball, paddle surfing, kayaking, sunset sailing, seafront cycling/walking
results.why_it_is_special: The city's most iconic beach, steps from the historic centre, with a lively atmosphere and a full range of water sports plus beachside dining

results.name: Montserrat Natural Park
results.principal_activities: Hiking the Sant Jeroni peak trail, visiting the mountain-top monastery, riding the cable car or funicular, nature photography
results.why_it_is_special: A dramatic serrated-rock massif rising to 1,236 m, home to the historic Benedictine monastery and the Black Madonna; widely considered the top nature day trip from Barcelona

results.name: Sitges & Parc del Garraf
results.principal_activities: Beach-going, coastal walking, hiking the Garraf hills for elevated Mediterranean views, exploring the artistic old town
results.why_it_is_special: A picturesque coastal town with beautiful beaches backed by the Garraf natural park, whose trails offer panoramic sea views and can be linked into a thru-hike ending in Sitges

results.name: Costa Brava (Tossa de Mar)
results.recommendation_type: Day trip (~1.5 hrs by train to Girona + bus)
results.principal_activities: Snorkelling in coves, coastal-path walking, kayaking, exploring the medieval walled old town
results.why_it_is_special: Dramatic rocky coastline with crystal-clear coves, a fortified medieval village, and some of the most scenic coastal scenery in the western Mediterranean
